infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Roava uses your location while you record a hike or run.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Roava uses your location during an activity, including when the screen is locked, so your route and distance keep recording.

plugins.photosPermission: Roava can access your photos when you choose to save a route card.
